meta.name: Kaiju
meta.description: A huge mud monster claws up out of the ground and stays for a few full turn rotations. Enemy tanks that come near are hauled overhead and hurled far away to slam into the ground; enemy shells that fly near it are caught and hurled to random spots on the map; houses and trees in reach are ripped apart and thrown. It never touches its summoner's team, and sinks back when its time is up. Dig the ground out from under it and it topples over and bursts, flinging every tank nearby.
